statements.text: Flaunch feeSplit() on a 10000-unit post-referral fee input quotes 0 bid-wall units, 9000 creator units and 1000 protocol units; this is configuration, not receipts.
Flaunch creator() returns 0x8aa48dfe58f84d85d41706543432e5d8511e90da; hook owner() returns 0xb8a70b4d1547bf6193bd67a73f4f98ea9fd0a973; fee calculator is 0xdbc2f399bbac8cd766f20c9b917a9a6ecad5bc4b.

Flaunch hook reports fee escrow 0x17fbf54d6d15ebff82eee77e616f701952d08bb4 and bid wall 0x0dae90b70f62ce3b1d5278f4763bd1f595d6a687; isBidWallEnabled() returns true for this pool. Enabled state does not establish a purchase, burn or permanent liquidity.
